messages:
Tammy: Heads up 1: FinReg bank POC asks for EU-only residency + explicit subprocessor list. Also want a documented manual US failover path (customer approval required) and an estimated cost delta for warm standby GPUs. cc @jon @sara
Jon: Are they asking for tenant-level pinning or per-request headers? Tenant pinning affects embedding indices and KV caches.
Tammy: Tenant-level pinning in contract, POC can be pinned too.
Sara: Short answers: regions available: europe-west1, europe-central1. We support tenant pin (region_pin) and a fallback policy that can be set to manual approval for non-EU targets.
Pricing: warm standby reserved capacity ~ +17-22% depending on committed term. Cross-region read-replicas for embeddings add ~+7% storage/ops. Egress billed at cloud egress + small routing surcharge.
ops_bot: Sample minimal failover runbook:
1) Detect region impairment (3m consecutive health failures)
2) Ops create incident and notify customer
3) Customer issues manual failover approval via Console API
4) Control plane flips routing to approved fallback region
5) Standby servers take traffic; telemetry flagged; replay disabled until post-mortem.
Tammy: Can you paste a short JSON routing sample I can include in the POC brief?
Sara: Example:
{"tenant_id":"finreg","routing":{"primary_region":"europe-west1","fallback":[{"region":"europe-central1","type":"automatic"},{"region":"us-central1","type":"manual_approval"}],"enforce_region_pin":true,"embeddings_replication":"disabled"}}
Tammy: Infosec asked which subprocessors see logs/telemetry for EU tenants and whether any telemetry is sent to US analytics.
legal_bot: We'll produce a subprocessor manifest (name, role, country, certs). By default logs/objects for EU tenants are stored in-region. Aggregated pseudonymized metrics may be replicated to US analytic clusters for platform optimization but can be disabled in DPA for enterprise customers. We can offer SCCs + DPA addendum with a "no-us-telemetry" clause.
pricing: I'll attach a line-item table for hosted vs dedicated vs private and a 12-month reserved example showing amortized standby cost.
Tammy: Great. Please upload subprocessor CSV, DPA draft, and pricing sheet to the deal folder by EOD. I'll update the POC agenda and tell the customer we can provide region pinning, manual approval failover, subprocessor list, and a DPA addendum.
Jon: LGTM. I'll also note RTO ~5-10min for traffic cutover with warmed standby; RPO depends on KV/embedding replication settings.
Tammy: Thanks team :thumbsup:
